title_en: IGN 30 Anniversary Bundle Is Live at Humble: $15 for 7 PC Games, Including Subnautica and Remnant 2
summary_en: IGN is 30, and to celebrate, we've teamed up with Humble to offer a bundle of 7 excellent PC games for just $15.
body_en:
Did you know that this very website is now 30 years old? Look at the logo at the top of this page if you don't believe me. To celebrate, the IGN 30 Anniversary Bundle is now live, which getes you seven Steam PC games for just $15 on Humble. The games are all worth checking out, and genre-wise there’s a little something for everyone. There’s an MMO, a Souls-like shooter, a survival game, and more. Let’s dive in.
It’s hard to say which game is the headliner here, as a number of them could take that role. The game with the most content has to be the MMO The Elder Scrolls Online - Elsweyr. It includes the base game, plus the Elsweyr, Morrowind, and Summerset chapters. The Elsweyr expansion specifically introduced the Necromancer class as well as dragon hunts, which are pretty exciting. That’s hundreds of hours’ worth of first-person MMO action (and it even runs great on Steam Deck, where I’ve been playing it).
Also included in the collection is Remnant II, an excellent Soulslike game with guns and sprinkling of looter-shooter action baked into it. We gave it a 9/10 in our review a few years back.
Roguelite fans can enjoy BlazBlue Entropy Effect, while survival types can try to live to swim another day in Subnautica, which our reviewer gave a 9.1/10 back in the decimal-loving days of 2018. Thronebreaker: The Witcher Tales got a 9.4/10 review that same year, with our critic calling it, “one of the best-written RPGs I’ve played in years.”
Then there’s Sonic Adventures 2, a PC port of a beloved Sega Dreamcast game, and the top-down roguelike action game Ravenswatch.
All told, this bundle gets you $214 worth of PC games for just $15. Or you can buy in at a lower tier for less. Any way you slice it, it’s a terrific deal, especially if you haven’t played any (or even some) of the games included.
The bundle will be available until October 9, so you have a few weeks to ponder the deal.
